title: Lightning Impacts on Global Forest and Carbon Dynamics: Current Understanding and Knowledge Gaps
content: Lightning is a fundamental Earth system process that influences the world's major forest biomes and their carbon storage through two primary pathways. Lightning is the major cause of boreal forest fires, while lightning strikes kill patches of trees in tropical forests. We summarized the current understanding of these processes and identified knowledge gaps.
